race.comment: JOURAMA (9) wasn't far away fresh off a long break, winding up strongly to finish fifth at Bairnsdale. Fitter for it and despite the wide gate should be hitting the line hard. BLUE PARROT (3) has been freshened since finishing fifth over 1000m at Bairnsdale. Filled a placing in a recent Traralgon trial. Should be thereabouts. BOHEMIAN BLITZ (8) Prague gelding on debut. Has had four hit-outs leading into this, the latest when placing in a Sandown-Hillside jump-out. Watch the market. NATIVE SPIRIT (17) is resuming from a break. Fitter for a recent jump-out at Cranbourne. Can add some value to all multiples.
